description: Manages the semantic index: status, build, refresh. Call with action=status when brain_search complains the index is missing; with action=rebuild to build it for the first time or after changing the model; with action=sync to pull in changes (fast, new material only). The first build on a large brain takes minutes.

action.description: status — look only; rebuild — build from scratch; sync — catch up.

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

name: brain_index
